about: Winkler is a city in southern Manitoba’s Pembina Valley, a fast-growing Mennonite-heritage community south of Winnipeg near the U.S. border. Manufacturing, agriculture, and a bilingual English–German cultural mix shape a prairie service centre. About 14,000 people live in Winkler.
seoSummary: Pembina Valley city in southern Manitoba—Mennonite heritage, manufacturing, and a growing prairie service centre.
